title: Sectionwise tensor evaluation comparison
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe max(c,v,r), J a Grothendieck topology, B,tau and D,sigma inverse sequences of commutative ring sheaves, alpha_n : B_n to D_n level maps, phi a morphism of their ring systems, M a B-system, and n a natural number [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Assume phi has component alpha_n at every (n,U). There are sectionwise D_n(U)-linear isomorphisms from changeOfRingsPresheaf(alpha_n, evaluation_n M)(U) to the coefficient-transported restriction of changeOfRingsPresheaf(phi,M) at (n,U). Each isomorphism sends the pure tensor a tensor x to the corresponding raw-system tensor a tensor x.

source.place: Section 03EK (section-tensor-product) and Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), applied to vertical restriction in blueprint classes (2)

proof.text: The coefficient morphism has components alpha_n by hypothesis, and the coefficient transports from evaluation_ring are identity ring maps. Substitute these ring-map equalities in the two extension-of-scalars modules. They become identical, and their identity isomorphism has the displayed value on pure tensors.

theorem scalarExtension_evaluation_objects
    (M : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ,
    (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{v, c, max c v r}
      (α n) ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M)).obj U ≅
      ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward (F := Prod.sectR n C)
        (eqToHom (evaluation_ring.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ n).symm).hom).obj
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{v, c, max c v r}
            φ M)).obj U,
      ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a : (D n).obj.obj U) (x : M.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
        (e U).hom (a ⊗ₜ[(B n).obj.obj U,((α n).hom.app U).hom] x) =
          (show (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ).obj.obj (op (n, U.unop)) from a)
            ⊗ₜ[(B n).obj.obj U,(φ.hom.app (op (n, U.unop))).hom] x
